scenarios.name: HTTP Server Startup and Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify that the HTTP server starts correctly alongside the existing TCP Memcached server and respects TOML configuration parameters

steps.description: Add HTTP configuration section with enabled=true and custom address to mirdb.toml
steps.context: HTTP server configuration should follow existing TOML patterns (NFR-5)

steps.description: Launch mirdb-server with the configuration file containing HTTP settings
steps.context: Both TCP and HTTP servers should initialize in the Tokio runtime

steps.description: Confirm HTTP server binds to configured address and responds to requests
steps.context: HTTP server must run alongside TCP server without port conflicts

test_cases.input: Start server with http.enabled=true and http.addr='127.0.0.1:8080'
test_cases.expected: HTTP server starts on port 8080, TCP server starts on default port 12333
Only TCP server starts, HTTP endpoints return connection refused
HTTP server binds to all interfaces on port 9090

test_cases.input: Start server with conflicting port (same as Memcached)
test_cases.expected: Server fails to start with clear error message about port conflict

test_cases.input: Start server without HTTP config section
test_cases.expected: HTTP server disabled by default, only TCP server runs
